rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who refuses to change their opinion or behaviour.

example.english: They are really stubborn; no matter how much we advise them, they refuse to change.
example.traditional: 佢真係好固執，點勸都唔肯改。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gu3 zap1 dim2 hyun3 dou1 m4 hang2 goi2

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice especially for a person who stubbornly refuses advice or will not cooperate.

example.english: You're so stubborn that you won't even listen when we tell you to wear a helmet.
example.traditional: 你咁硬頸，叫你戴頭盔都唔聽。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 ngaang6 geng2 giu3 nei5 daai3 tau4 kwai1 dou1 m4 teng1

rows.note: Use this colloquial, somewhat vivid choice when someone is being particularly unyielding or difficult.

example.english: This customer is really stubborn; even after talking for so long, they still won't agree to a refund.
example.traditional: 呢個客真係牛皮，講咗咁耐都唔肯退款。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 haak3 zan1 hai6 ngau4 pei4 gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 m4 hang2 teoi3 fun2

rows.note: Use this for a physically stiff object or material that is difficult to operate, melt, or work.

example.english: This stubborn beef stays tough no matter how you cook it.
example.traditional: 呢嚿牛肉太硬，點煮都唔腍。
example.jyutping: ni1 gau6 ngau4 juk6 taai3 ngaang6 dim2 zyu2 dou1 m4 nam4
